author: Yffe
content: Built increment 1d-ii in lean/Thermite/{Ast,Denote,RefEncode,Soundness}.lean: extended CombName with countWhere (VALUE-combinator, recursive nat count via the shared structural countWhereVal — core Lean, NO Mathlib, NO fuel; faithful to the verus_l3 if/drop_first/decreases form EXACTLY) + permutationOf (Prop-combinator, MULTISET equality via the count-characterization permEq := forall x, a.count x = b.count x — core List.count, NOT Mathlib Multiset). Merged the refVal_eq/ref_sound mutual blocks so refIntVal's count_where arm can reference refDenote for the predicate; ref_sound now covers both (contract sublanguage 8/8 COMPLETE). Negative lemmas bite: count_where wrong-predicate + off-by-one; permutation_of multiset-vs-SET (witness [1,1,2]/[1,2,2]). lake build green, axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] (no sorryAx), cargo build --workspace green. Core Lean sufficed — no Mathlib wall.
